text:
maria: FYI AcmeCorp just opened a ticket — p99 for their Dedicated pool jumped from ~750ms to ~4.2s starting ~08:12 UTC. Saw lots of complaints in support inbox. traces: https://redwood/traces/abc123

samir: Can you drop the pool id + customer id? Any auth 5xxs in the logs or specifically attach/cold-start errors?

maria: customer_id: ACME-42, pool: dedicated-eu-west-3-prod-07. Sample error lines:
```
[08:12:18] attach: timeout waiting for warm gpu (timeout=8s) tenant=ACME-42 request_id=rtr_7b3
[08:12:19] attach: fallback to cold-gpu-init tenant=ACME-42 request_id=rtr_7b4
[08:12:20] provisioner: no available min-pool slot, queued(312) pool=dedicated-eu-west-3-prod-07
```

elaine: Looks like a classic attach surge. Any correlation with billing window / cron jobs? :thinking:

jonah: Customer says they run a nightly batch at 08:10 UTC to generate embeddings for invoices. That could explain spike.

samir: Checking metrics now — queue length spiked from 10 -> 320 in ~90s. Active GPUs at pool cap (16), attach success rate dropped, attach latency p95/p99 shot up. Also seeing many cold-init events within the same minute (thundering herd).

samir: Immediate mitigation options:
- bump min capacity for dedicated-eu-west-3-prod-07 by +2 (temporary)
- enable tenant hotattach priority (so ACME gets proportion of warm slots)
- route ACME to hosted fallback pool for burst if allowed by policy

maria: Customer is OK with a temporary bump, asked for ETA to reduce p99s.

jonah: I can push a +2 override now. Applying...

ops-bot: [autoscaler] override applied: pool=dedicated-eu-west-3-prod-07 min_replicas +2 by jonah at 08:20:34 UTC

samir: After override, queue length dropped to ~60 in 45s, p95 down to 1.1s, p99 ~1.9s. Still above normal but much better.

maria: Customer thread replied: "latency improved but still seeing spikes during job start, can you repro?"

elaine: Want to capture repro steps — can we ask ACME to stagger their batch start by 1s jitter? If not, we should implement internal jittered pre-warm and reduce attach timeout.

samir: Root cause hypothesis: synchronized batch at billing window causes large number of new sessions that miss KV cache and require cold kernel init. Also our fairshare scheduling currently hands out warm slots round-robin which can starve tenants with bursty needs.

samir: Action items (short-term):
- Keep +2 override until end of customer's billing window (ops: jonah)
- Enable hosted fallback path for bursts for this tenant (requires consent) (maria)
- Create a temporary per-tenant hotattach priority flag (eng-platform)

samir: Action items (long-term):
- Implement jittered pre-warm heuristic around known cron windows
- Reduce attach timeout to fail faster and trigger fallback earlier
- Add predictive pre-warm based on observed schedules and billing events
- Revisit pool sizing in regions with many scheduled batch customers

jonah: I'll keep override for 2 hours and monitor. Filing ticket INF-4721 to track long-term fixes.

acct-cs: Customer note: "Thanks — performance much better now. We'll try staggering tomorrow and let you know." :thumbsup:

maria: Leaving this thread open. I'll follow up after overnight window. Will attach traces and perf graphs to INF-4721.

samir: Also adding an alert tweak: trigger an urgent page if queue > 200 and attach success < 60% for more than 1m — we missed that threshold earlier.

elaine: Good call. Postmortem draft assigned to samir + maria + jonah.

maria: Closing for now, will update when billing window completes.
